name: Tudkiya Bhath
instructions: 1. Wash and soak the rice and lentils for 20 minutes. 2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and add whole spices (cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaf). 3. Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown. 4. Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. 5. Add cubed potatoes, tomatoes, and dry powdered spices, cooking until the oil separates. 6. Add the soaked rice and lentils, stirring gently to coat with the masala. 7. Pour in water and a splash of yogurt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat until the rice and lentils are tender. 8. Fluff with a fork and serve hot, traditionally with mash dal.
description: Tudkiya Bhath is a traditional Himachali pulao-style dish. It is a hearty comfort food often prepared during local festivities and social gatherings, reflecting the simple yet robust flavors of the mountainous region.
